patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Coralogix and Elastic Observability share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Coralogix and Elastic Observability share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Coralogix only if your buying job matches “Observability usage rate card — Logs $0.42/GB, Traces $0.16/GB, Metrics $0.06/GB, AI $1.50” rather than Elastic Observability's shape. Choose Elastic Observability only if your buying job matches “Observability on Elastic Cloud — Hosted Standard from $99/mo (120 GB / 2 zones); Serverles” rather than Coralogix's shape. Workflow advantage differs because Coralogix is shaped for Observability usage rate card — Logs $0.42/GB, Traces $0.16/GB, Metric whereas Elastic Observability is shaped for Observability on Elastic Cloud — Hosted Standard from $99/mo (120 GB /. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Coralogix and Elastic Observability share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Coralogix is Observability usage rate card — Logs $0.42/GB, Traces $0.16/GB, Metrics $0.06/GB, AI $1.50/1M tokens; 14-day / 8-unit trial. No seat floor. ; Elastic Observability is Observability on Elastic Cloud — Hosted Standard from $99/mo (120 GB / 2 zones); Serverless Observability usage from ~$0.07–$0.09/GB ingest;.
- Researched limits: Coralogix — Does not outrank Datadog (8.6); Elastic Observability — This entity is Elastic Observability on Cloud — not “Elasticsearch search product only”.

Limitations — Coralogix: Does not outrank Datadog (8.6); No published seat floor — GB/token math still dominates TCO; Elastic Observability: This entity is Elastic Observability on Cloud — not “Elasticsearch search product only”; $99 Hosted Standard is a small 120 GB / 2-zone floor; real TCO follows resources.

Poor-fit cases: Coralogix is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Does not outrank Datadog (8.6) · Elastic Observability is a poor fit when that limitation bites: This entity is Elastic Observability on Cloud — not “Elasticsearch search product only” · Avoid Coralogix if you actually need Elastic Observability's motion (Observability on Elastic Cloud — Hosted Standard from $99/mo (120 GB / 2 zones);)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
